THE HUMAN BEHIND THE BRAND WORLDS

Hi, I’m Diti.
Let’s make
something feel.

Brand identity designer, packaging enthusiast and professional overthinker of colour palettes.

I started Chavi Designs to turn small ideas into brands with heart, humour and a whole little world of their own. I create identities, packaging, illustrations, social and print that feel connected — from the big picture to the tiniest detail.

For me, a café should feel warm before you visit. A chai brand should invite you in before the first sip. That’s the kind of connection I love designing.

HOW I SEE THINGS

A little heart.
A lot of intention.

01

Story comes first.

Before colours and type, we explore your audience, your goals and the feeling you want your brand to create.

02

Personality matters.

Playful or quietly refined, your identity should express what makes you interesting. There’s no one-size-fits-all here.

03

It all belongs together.

Your identity, packaging, social and print should feel like parts of the same story. One flexible world that grows with you.

A FEW VERY SERIOUS DESIGN TRUTHS

I will notice the font
on the café menu.

I’ll also save 47 references and call it research, admire the packaging at the grocery store, and believe a good colour palette can fix your mood.
